page_title: Image to HTML CSS converter — turn a design into a live site

summary.name: Fronty
summary.one_liner: Fronty is an AI tool that converts a screenshot or JPEG/PNG image into HTML/CSS code and provides a no-code editor to build, edit, and publish the resulting website.
use_cases: Turning a design screenshot into HTML/CSS code
Building a website without writing code
Adding a database and forms to a site
Connecting a custom domain and publishing a site
summary.what_it_does: The page says Fronty uses AI to generate HTML and CSS source code from a screenshot or JPEG/PNG image, typically within a few minutes. The generated code can then be maintained in its no-code editor, where users edit pages by clicking. The builder also supports adding a database and forms, connecting a domain, and publishing the site. The page claims over 1M websites have been created with it, but gives no methodology for that figure.
notable: Image/screenshot to HTML CSS conversion with AI
Click-to-edit no-code editor for generated code
Built-in database, forms, custom domain and publishing
Product Hunt #1 Product of the Day and Golden Kitty Awards winner (as stated on page)
caveats: Page says 'Free to start, no card needed' but does not detail paid tier limits
Output quality and accuracy of conversion are not described on the page
Award and user-count claims are self-reported marketing statements
